# Issues are for bugs and feature requests only

Usage questions opened as issues are closed. Instead:

1. Read the [guides](https://philjay.cc/mpandroidchart/docs/) and the [API reference](https://jitpack.io/#PhilJay/MPAndroidChart).
1. Look at the [example app](https://github.com/PhilJay/MPAndroidChart/tree/master/MPChartExample), which covers every chart type and most features.
1. Ask on [Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/mpandroidchart) with the `mpandroidchart` tag.
